c74object.name: el.oscil~
c74object.digest: Flexible wavetable and additive synthesis oscillator
c74object.description:
el.oscil~ is a versatile wavetable and additive synthesis oscillator. It generates standard band-limited waveforms (sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, buzz) or arbitrary user-defined spectra using additive synthesis (list, amph). When changing waveforms during performance, the oscillator performs smooth, click-free crossfades using linear or equal-power curves. Both frequency and phase offset (0.0 to 1.0) can be controlled via control messages or modulated continuously at audio rate.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / float / messages): Oscillator frequency in Hertz, and control message inlet (sine, sawtooth, square, triangle, buzz, list, amph, fadetime, fadetype, interpolate, harmcount).
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Phase offset ranging from 0.0 to 1.0.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Synthesized oscillator audio output.

inlet.description: Sets oscillator frequency in Hertz, and accepts waveform-switching and additive synthesis messages.
Normalized phase offset ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Accepts float messages or audio-rate signals.

objarg.name: frequency
objarg.description: Initial oscillator frequency in Hertz (default: 440.0 Hz).

objarg.name: table-length
objarg.description: Resolution of the internal wavetable in samples (default: 8192, range: 4 to 1,048,576).

objarg.name: waveform
objarg.description: Initial waveform shape: sine (default), triangle, square, sawtooth, or buzz.

objarg.name: harmonic-count
objarg.description: Number of harmonics used to synthesize band-limited waveforms (default: 10, maximum: 1024).

method.name: amph
method.digest: Define spectrum with amplitudes and phases
method.description: Builds a custom waveform with independent amplitude and phase control for each partial. The first value specifies DC offset. Following values are pairs of amplitude and phase (0.0 to 1.0 cycles) for each harmonic: [DC, amp1, phase1, amp2, phase2, ...]. The resulting wavetable is automatically normalized to peak amplitude 1.0.

method.name: buzz
method.description: Generates a band-limited buzz / impulse wave containing all harmonics up to harmcount at equal amplitude.

method.name: fadetime
method.description: Sets the crossfade duration in milliseconds when transitioning between different waveforms (default: 50.0 ms).

method.name: fadetype
method.description:
Selects the crossfade interpolation curve used during waveform transitions:
• 0: No fade (instantaneous switch)
• 1: Linear crossfade (default)
• 2: Equal-power crossfade

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 1 sets oscillator frequency in Hertz. Float sent to inlet 2 sets phase offset (0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: harmcount
method.digest: Set harmonic count for band-limited waves
method.description: Sets the maximum number of harmonics synthesized for band-limited waves (triangle, square, sawtooth, and buzz).

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float to set frequency (inlet 1) or phase offset (inlet 2).

method.name: interpolate
method.description: When set to 1, enables linear interpolation when reading the wavetable, reducing quantization distortion. When set to 0 (default), nearest-sample truncation is used.

method.name: list
method.description: Builds a custom waveform from a list of harmonic weights in sine phase. The first value specifies DC offset; subsequent values specify the relative amplitudes of harmonics 1, 2, 3, etc. The resulting wavetable is automatically normalized to peak amplitude 1.0.

method.name: sawtooth
method.description: Generates a band-limited sawtooth wave up to harmcount harmonics.

method.name: sine
method.description: Sets the waveform to a pure sine wave.

method.name: square
method.description: Generates a band-limited square wave up to harmcount harmonics.

method.name: triangle
method.description: Generates a band-limited triangle wave up to harmcount harmonics.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 controls frequency in Hertz. Signal arriving at inlet 2 continuously modulates the phase offset (0.0 to 1.0) at audio rate.
